name: Longer Ray7S 15W
tagline: The value Ray7S: a 15W diode in a Class 1 cabinet that engraves finely and cuts 3 mm wood
tldr: The Ray7S 15W costs $369.99 for the Basic Set on Longer's store (October 2026). Inside the same Class 1 cabinet with Klipper firmware and a 305 × 310 mm bed, its 0.06 × 0.08 mm diode stays fine enough for photos while cutting 3 mm basswood in one pass by our estimate. It undercuts the cheapest enclosed xTool S1 by more than $600, with a smaller bed and no reviews yet.
mainObjective: Enclosed engraving with light cutting of 3–5 mm wood for a home workshop

priceRange.note: Official Longer store, Oct 2026: $369.99 Basic Set (list price $499.99)

beginnerNotes: This profile is the 15W version of the Longer Ray7S. It suits home users who want a closed laser for engraving with occasional cuts in 3 mm wood: ornaments, coasters, small boxes. Compare the other Ray7S versions with the chips above if you plan to cut thicker plywood often. Add the optional air pump if you cut.
proTips: Fit the optional air pump before the first cuts; inside a closed cabinet it also helps clear smoke from the lens. Duct the exhaust out of a window for any cutting session. Keep the lid closed while the laser runs: the Class 1 rating only holds with it shut.

editorialDepth.advantages: The 15W Ray7S balances price and capability: a Class 1 cabinet, Klipper firmware and Wi-Fi, a fine spot for engraving and enough power for 3 mm hobby cuts, for well under $400.
editorialDepth.limitations: Thicker plywood needs several passes, and the 305 × 310 mm bed is modest. The air pump is extra. Cabinet sealing and extraction are untested by independent reviewers so far.

faq.question: How thick can the Ray7S 15W cut?
faq.answer: Longer does not publish per-version figures. By our estimate it cuts 3 mm basswood in one pass, about 5 mm with air assist, and 6 mm plywood in several passes.

faq.question: Ray7S 15W or Ray7S 20W?
faq.answer: The 20W costs $529.99 against $369.99 for the 15W Basic Set (Longer store, October 2026). The $160 step buys faster cuts in 5–8 mm wood; for engraving with light cuts, the 15W is enough and leaves budget for the air pump.

faq.question: Ray7S 15W or open Ray7 15W?
faq.answer: The open Ray7 15W costs $299.99, $70 less, with a larger 405 × 410 mm bed. The Ray7S adds the Class 1 cabinet and Klipper firmware: worth it if the laser shares a room with family or pets.
